command_line:
set -eu
gzip -cd "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79122640/inputs/dataset_55557638-e038-4fd4-98a1-c679102b3644.dat" > cohort_original.tped
nl -ba -n rz -w 9 -s ' ' cohort_original.tped | sed 's/^\([0-9]*\)[[:space:]][[:space:]]*\([^[:space:]]*\)[[:space:]][[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]*/\2 VAR_\1/' > cohort.tped
cp "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79122640/inputs/dataset_a409a90f-c87d-4d38-b556-c31f780b985a.dat" cohort.tfam
plink --tfile cohort --allow-no-sex --autosome --snps-only just-acgt --maf 0.05 --geno 0.02 --mind 0.02 --make-bed --threads "$GALAXY_SLOTS" --out qc
plink --bfile qc --allow-no-sex --indep-pairwise 50 5 0.2 --threads "$GALAXY_SLOTS" --out prune
plink --bfile qc --allow-no-sex --extract prune.prune.in --genome full --min 0.375 --threads "$GALAXY_SLOTS" --out kin
cp kin.genome first_degree_pairs.tsv
sed '1d; s/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]][[:space:]]*/ /g' kin.genome | cut -d ' ' -f 2,4 | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -u | paste -sd, - > answer.txt
if [ ! -s answer.txt ]; then printf 'None\n' > answer.txt; fi
